metrics.oracle: SURV-06, D44/D48, gate H5: a declared way is used at least once in a world where it can be (the hunt instance: every feeding kill is eaten from somewhere)
Bible 03 conservation, gate H7: meat leaves a body only by being taken, by the whole body being looted, or through the MEAT_DECAYED sink, and made = taken + looted + vanished + remaining

D43, D44, gate H4: a kind whose diet lacks a food class never eats it (the inn's meal needs prepared, checked by the transfer it was served through; every other meal is a consumption of an item, counted when its class is outside the eater's diet). Picking up or carrying a non-diet item is not a V4 breach
LAW-POSITION-IN-WORLD, Bible 06 topology: a moved, alive entity stays inside the world extent
